name: opencode-agent-pulse
description: OpenCode TUI plugin that live-displays running subagents in the sidebar with busy/idle status, elapsed time, and click-through to the sub-session context.
author: zouyu

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap=inline && bun build src/tui.ts --outfile dist/tui.js --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js --external node-notifier --external "node:*" --sourcemap=inline && bun run scripts/fix-sourcemaps.ts
